tasks.title: Question 31
tasks.promptText: Tom wants to talk about small birthday gift. what gift to choose. where to buy it. when to give it.

promptBlocks.text: Read this email from your English friend Tom.

promptBlocks.subject: A birthday present
paragraphs: I am writing about small birthday gift. what gift to choose? where to buy it?
when to give it? Please write soon.

promptBlocks.text: Write an email to Tom and answer the questions.

tasks.title: Question 32
tasks.promptText: Look at the three pictures. Write the story shown in the pictures.

ketImageBrief.title: small birthday gift
ketImageBrief.panel1: Tom starts small birthday gift with a clear plan.
ketImageBrief.panel2: A small problem changes the plan.
ketImageBrief.panel3: Tom solves it and finishes happily.
continuityNotes: Keep the same child and objects in all three panels.
